    $$1.5 \text{ lbs} \pounds \pounds \times \$8/\text{lb} = \$12.00 \text{ (since } 1.5 \times 8 = 12\text{)$$
*   **Fruit:** The problem specifies 2 pounds of fruit at $6 per pound.
